summary: Sh. Ali Mashhour continues his lecture on Al-Wajeez, focusing on the book of Salah and the dangers of abandoning prayer. He presents different scenarios of Muslims' prayer habits, from those who pray regularly to those who never pray. Using the analogy of building a house, Sh. Ali Mashhour explains that Salah is like the foundational pillars and structure of Islam, while other good deeds are like decorative elements. He emphasizes that just as a building without proper foundations will collapse during a storm, a person without a strong foundation of prayer will be unprepared when facing life's crises or death. Sh. Ali Mashhour warns against false comfort from misconceptions like "Allah is merciful, so I don't need to pray" or minimal foundations being sufficient, stressing that one cannot build spiritual strength during times of trial.
suggested_title: The Dangers of Abandoning Salah: Building Your House Before the Storm
catchy_title: Can you build your house during the storm?
